clusters.name: validator-core
clusters.executionModeRationale: Foundational module every other story imports/invokes; must land first before fixtures, tests, or wiring can verify against it.

clusters.name: fixtures-and-test
clusters.executionModeRationale: Test-only files, disjoint from the release-wiring cluster; parallel-safe once the validator module exists.

clusters.name: release-wiring-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Skill/doc edits, disjoint from the test cluster; parallel-safe once the validator module exists. Small surface — may also run serially.
